title: Cytochrome P450 enzymes in the biosynthesis of bioactive diterpenoids from traditional chinese medicinal plants.
authors: Zhang, Zheng; Li, Wei; Li, Hong
one_liner_zh: 综述P450酶在中药二萜生物合成中的催化机制，并展望AI辅助蛋白设计，但核心是生物合成而非蛋白质结构计算建模，仅部分涉及结构预测和设计。
abstract: Cytochrome P450 enzymes play key catalytic roles in the biosynthesis of diterpenoid natural products from traditional Chinese medicinal plants. Operating through a conserved heme-thiolate catalytic cycle and Compound I-driven oxidation, these enzymes mediate most post-cyclization oxidative tailoring of diterpene scaffolds, including hydroxylation, epoxidation, carbon-skeleton rearrangement, and lactone formation. This review surveys the biosynthetic pathways of seven representative diterpenoids, namely tanshinones, paclitaxel, triptolide, andrographolide, ginkgolides, forskolin, and oridonin, in which sequential site-selective hydroxylation and multifunctional catalysis are recurring features, whereas carbon-skeleton remodeling proceeds through pathway-specific modes, including Wagner-Meerwein methyl migration in triptolide, NIH-shift alkyl migration and dual C-C bond cleavage in ginkgolides, and oxidative oxetane-ring formation in paclitaxel, with lactone ring construction observed in the andrographolide, triptolide, and ginkgolide pathways. Atomic-level studies of representative enzymes CYP76AH1, CYP725A4, TOT1, and TmCYP1 further clarify how substrate recognition, regioselectivity, and catalytic trajectories are governed within the active site, providing a basis for rational enzyme engineering. Finally, the prospects of artificial intelligence-assisted protein design for engineering P450 catalytic elements are discussed, encompassing structure prediction, protein language model-based mutational prescreening, and de novo catalytic-pocket design, along with their potential to facilitate heterologous biosynthesis and the sustainable production of bioactive diterpenoids from medicinal plants.
abstract_zh: 细胞色素P450酶在传统药用植物二萜类天然产物的生物合成中发挥关键催化作用。通过保守的血红素-硫醇盐催化循环和化合物I驱动的氧化机制，这些酶介导了二萜骨架环化后的大部分氧化修饰，包括羟基化、环氧化、碳骨架重排和内酯形成。本综述考察了七种代表性二萜类化合物的生物合成途径，即丹参酮 (tanshinones)、紫杉醇 (paclitaxel)、雷公藤甲素 (triptolide)、穿心莲内酯 (andrographolide)、银杏内酯 (ginkgolides)、毛喉素 (forskolin) 和冬凌草甲素 (oridonin)，其中连续位点选择性羟基化和多功能催化是反复出现的特征，而碳骨架重塑则通过途径特异性模式进行，包括雷公藤甲素中的Wagner-Meerwein甲基迁移、银杏内酯中的NIH-移位烷基迁移和双C-C键断裂，以及紫杉醇中的氧化性氧杂环丁烷环形成，同时在穿心莲内酯、雷公藤甲素和银杏内酯途径中观察到内酯环构建。对代表性酶CYP76AH1、CYP725A4、TOT1和TmCYP1的原子水平研究进一步阐明了底物识别、区域选择性和催化轨迹如何在活性位点内被调控，为理性酶工程提供了基础。最后，讨论了人工智能辅助蛋白质设计用于工程化P450催化元件的前景，涵盖结构预测、基于蛋白质语言模型的突变预筛选和从头催化口袋设计，及其促进药用植物生物活性二萜类化合物异源生物合成和可持续生产的潜力。
